query:
with cte as (
    insert into user_font
    (user_id, name, index)
    values ($1, $2, (select count(*) from user_font where user_id = $1)) returning name
), names as (
    select name
    from user_font
    where user_id = $1
    order by index
)
select name as "name!" from names
union all
select name as "name!" from cte
